verdict.rationale: Mailgun docs confirm real-time webhook event delivery (mailgun-docs-8) and related event handling like bounce tracking and complaint/unsubscribe management (mailgun-docs-12, mailgun-docs-34), implying delivered/bounced/complained event types. However, no evidence pack item documents specific retry behavior, retry schedules, or signature verification details for webhook delivery guarantees. missing for 10: explicit list of webhook event types (delivered/bounced/complained) with schema, documented retry/backoff policy for failed webhook deliveries, and independent confirmation of webhook reliability.
